description: The only inputs this package accepts for development analysis. Hashes are the gate: a file whose SHA256 differs is refused, never adapted to. No activation data is stored in this repository; the array is read in place from the path given in configs/paths.local.json.

extraction_manifest.role: row order of the activation array
extraction_manifest.ordering: ascending row_id; row_index equals the array row position

activation.role: residual stream at the final prompt token, one unsteered forward pass per prompt

state_numbering.0: embedding output at the final prompt token
state_numbering.note: state 0 is not a transformer block and must not be called layer 0

refused_inputs.reason: superseded label revisions kept beside the accepted file in the historical workspace; two of them carry more authoritative-sounding names than the accepted one

notes.rq3_geometry_prepare_20260803_215218: E=116 B=180; original labels, and frozen folds built on them
